work.title: Untitled (CD Installation)
work.description: Large-scale installation composed of silver foil panels, FedEx packaging tape, and rows of compact discs arranged along vertical columns and a horizontal base register. Central panel features a framed botanical still-life painting with a single disc affixed to its surface, flanked by a cassette tape unit.
work.composition: symmetrical triptych with horizontal base row
keywords: botanical painting embedded in CD grid
